cause.finding: The frozen driver calculated one sleep target at last_dispatch + 5.1 seconds and trusted the sleep return; Windows timer undershoot/rounding left dispatch timestamps below the floor.
cause.boundary: execution defect; no new network finding

v3_fix.mechanism: monotonic deadline loop with post-sleep re-read; UTC request-start floor retained for restart continuity
v3_fix.restart_rule: map persisted dispatch_utc into the new process monotonic origin; never compare unrelated monotonic origins directly
v3_fix.restart_scope: fixture timing helper only; execute does not auto-resume an interrupted progress journal and refuses raw-path overwrite
v3_fix.remaining_byte_time_clamp: computed after cadence wait from total bytes and remaining window; connect/max timeout and entity body cap are reduced together
v3_fix.disk_rule: recheck free space after cadence wait and persist disk_free_before_bytes with every durable dispatch reservation

historical_receipt_policy: The prior 5.093s deviation remains frozen and is not rewritten by this v3 artifact.
